lines: Fine. I will stand down, but peace takes more than payment.
I will let this pass for now. Do not make me <shake>regret</shake> it.
That is enough to cool my temper. Keep your hands peaceful.
This settles the moment, not the memory.
I will step back. You should spend this second chance carefully.
The payment helps. Better choices will help more.
Fine. Let this end here before it grows sharper.
I will accept this. Do not mistake that for forgetting.
Peace can start here, if you let it.
That is enough for now. Keep the rest of your actions <pulse>clean</pulse>.
All right. I will stand down.
You have my word that I will not strike first.
Fine. Let us end this before someone gets hurt.
I am lowering my guard, so do the same.
We can settle this without weapons.
I hear you. The fight ends here.
Take a step back and I will calm down.
No more threats from either of us.
I would rather walk away than make another enemy.
The village has seen enough violence today.
That is not enough. Bring {emerald_cost} {emeralds} if you want this settled.
You are short. Peace costs <color:green>{emerald_cost} {emeralds}</color> today.
A small offer will not calm a large mistake. I need {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
That does not cover it. Not even close.
If you mean to settle this, bring the full {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
You cannot buy peace with half the price.
The offer is too light for the damage done.
Put the weapon down and give everyone room to breathe.
That is not enough to cool anyone's temper.
Come back with <color:green>{emerald_cost} {emeralds}</color>, or choose another way.
That is not enough to settle this.
You are short on emeralds and I am short on patience.
Bring the full {emerald_cost} {emeralds} if you want peace.
The price does not shrink because your purse is light.
Come back when you can cover what you owe.
Half a payment buys no forgiveness.
I counted twice. You still do not have enough.
The village will not carry the rest of your debt.
You need {emerald_cost} {emeralds}, not another excuse.
No deal until the full amount is here.
<shake>No.</shake> Some things are not bought back with {payment_items}.
The village remembers too much for that to work.
No. The offer does not reach the damage yet.
Keep {payment_items}. This is not the kind of hurt they can fix.
You cannot press payment into a wound and call it healed.
Not from you. Not after what the village remembers.
That offer comes too late to sound peaceful.
No. Trust is not for sale today.
The damage is heavier than those {payment_items}.
<shake>Back away.</shake> This cannot be settled like that.
No payment makes you safe to trust right now.
The guards are already coming. Put everything down.
You crossed the point where bargaining could help.
Back away from the village and keep your offer.
People here are still hiding because of you.
I will not lower my guard while you remain a threat.
The damage is too serious for a private settlement.
No. This ends with you leaving, not paying.
Another step forward will be treated as an attack.
Your reputation has closed this conversation.
Keep them. I do not trust your apology.
No. I need distance before I can even consider an offer.
Keep {payment_items}. This is not ready to mend.
You cannot buy your way out of every memory.
No. I would rather keep my distance than take your payment.
That might settle a mistake. This is more than that.
The village is not ready to accept peace from your hand.
Your {payment_items} do not make me feel safer.
No. The wound is still too fresh for bargaining.
Keep the {payment_items}. I am keeping my <shake>caution</shake>.
I cannot accept {payment_items} while I am still afraid of you.
Keep the offer and give me time to think.
I am not ready to call this settled.
Payment would not make the next conversation feel safer.
Please leave the {payment_items} where they are.
I need distance more than I need compensation.
You may mean peace, but I cannot trust it today.
Ask again after your actions have changed what people expect.
Taking the offer now would feel like pretending.
No. Let me walk away without making this worse.
